scripts.format: biome format --write scripts src test package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.format:check: biome check --formatter-enabled=true --linter-enabled=false --assist-enabled=false scripts src test package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: biome lint scripts src test package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.qa: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
